_comment: Guideline source manifest. PDFs are NOT committed; run `python scripts/fetch_guidelines.py` to download them from the publisher and verify checksums. Parsing settings (TOC pages, header patterns, chapter detection, exclusions) are per document because layouts differ.

documents.title: Guidelines for Managing Substance Withdrawal in Jails: A Tool for Local Government Officials, Jail Administrators, Correctional Officers, and Health Care Professionals
documents.short_title: Guidelines for Managing Substance Withdrawal in Jails
documents.publisher: U.S. Department of Justice, Bureau of Justice Assistance (BJA) and National Institute of Corrections (NIC)
documents.usage_note: Public U.S. government publication distributed free of charge by BJA. Indexed locally for research/demonstration; the PDF itself is not redistributed in this repository. Photographs are third-party (iStock) and are not used.

page_label_patterns: ^\s*([0-9]+)(?=Guidelines for Managing Substance Withdrawal in Jails)
header_line_patterns: ^\s*[0-9]*Guidelines for Managing Substance Withdrawal in Jails\s*$
parsing.inline_header_strip_regex: ^[0-9]+Guidelines for Managing Substance Withdrawal in Jails
parsing.chapter_regex: ^(Introduction|The Withdrawal Management Process|General Guidance|Alcohol Withdrawal|Sedative Withdrawal|Opioid Withdrawal|Stimulant Withdrawal|Appendixes|Appendix [A-Z]:.*|Endnotes)$
parsing.exclude_reason: Excluded: appendix divider, development team (A), methodology (B), industry relationships and field reviewers (H-J), acronym list (L), resource list (M), and endnotes — non-clinical content that adds retrieval noise.

documents.title: Medically Supervised Withdrawal for Inmates with Substance Use Disorders (Federal Bureau of Prisons Clinical Guidance)
documents.short_title: BOP Clinical Guidance: Medically Supervised Withdrawal
documents.usage_note: BOP states this clinical guidance 'is made available to the public for informational purposes only.' Linked from https://www.bop.gov/resources/health_care_mngmt.jsp. Older than BJA-2023; retained as a second correctional-health source. Not redistributed in this repository.

header_line_patterns: ^\s*Federal Bureau of Prisons Medically Supervised Withdrawal\s*$
subsection_headings: DIAGNOSIS OF ALCOHOL USE DISORDERS AND WITHDRAWAL
ALTERNATIVE/ADJUNCTIVE TREATMENTS FOR MILD ALCOHOL WITHDRAWAL
OTHER ADJUNCTIVE TREATMENTS OF ALCOHOL WITHDRAWAL
DIAGNOSIS OF BENZODIAZEPINE USE DISORDERS AND WITHDRAWAL
SYMPTOMS AND SIGNS OF BENZODIAZEPINE WITHDRAWAL
DIAGNOSIS OF BARBITURATE USE DISORDER AND WITHDRAWAL
SYMPTOMS AND SIGNS OF BARBITURATE WITHDRAWAL
DIAGNOSIS AND EVALUATION OF OPIOID USE DISORDERS
parsing.exclude_reason: Excluded: reference list and appendices 5-8 (near-identical patient-education handouts that would crowd retrieval results).

not_included.reason: ASAM clinical practice guidelines are copyrighted journal publications; reuse/redistribution terms were not verified as permitting local indexing in a public portfolio repository. Excluded pending review. Note that BJA-2023 is endorsed by ASAM and ASAM staff contributed to it.
